snippet.title: Rebel Core: Video Reveal & Early Gameplay
snippet.description:
The Rebel Core video reveal featuring an early preview of gameplay and a look into the game's world. 

All gameplay and cinematics have been captured from real-time, in-engine footage using Unreal Engine 5.4.

This video is the sum of approximately 3 months of prototype development from our team of 3. All music used in the video is original and created by Dan Sandberg. 2025 Atom Switch, Inc. all rights reserved.
